items.title: CFP: Religion, Politics, and Cognitive Warfare
items.author: editors_religioustheory
items.description: This call for papers invites work on religion, politics, and cognitive warfare, exploring how belief, media, conspiracy, identity, and power shape struggles over reality, interpretation, and life in an age of disinformation, polarization, and contested truth. Essays may be theoretical, historical, or contemporary.

items.title: Journal for Cultural and Religious Theory Introduces DOIs
items.author: editors_religioustheory
items.description: The Journal for Cultural and Religious Theory (JCRT) is pleased to announce that, beginning with our next issue, every article we publish will be assigned a Digital Object Identifier (DOI). We are also undertaking a retroactive project to assign DOIs to our back catalog, so that the full body of JCRT scholarship becomes persistently citable and discoverable.

items.title: Registration Now Open: Religion, Politics, and Cognitive Warfare
items.author: editors_religioustheory
items.description: Registration is now open for the online JCRT conference Religion, Politics, and Cognitive Warfare: Information, Interpretation, Conspiracy, and the Struggle for Reality, taking place October 1-3, 2026.

items.title: JCRT Announces Volume 25, Issue 2: Interruption, Interdependence, and Re-Enchantment
items.author: adamdjbrett
items.description: JCRT Volume 25, Issue 2 brings ten essays into conversation around political theology, materiality, ecology, consciousness, performance, Sufism, and re-enchantment.

items.title: Every Article in the JCRT Archive Now Has a DOI
items.author: adam-dj-brett
items.description: All 829 articles in the numbered JCRT archive, from volume 1 in 1999 through volume 25 in 2026, now carry a Digital Object Identifier and are deposited in Knowledge Commons Works as 67 public issue collections.

items.author: editors_religioustheory
items.description: JCRT Relaunches Its Book Review Section, Inviting Graduate Students, Independent Scholars, and Faculty to Contribute

items.title: Call for Submissions
items.author: editors_religioustheory
items.description: The Journal for Cultural and Religious Theory (JCRT) invites submissions for the JCRT.org blog on a rolling basis. JCRT is a peer-reviewed journal devoted to both disciplinary and interdisciplinary scholarship of a cutting-edge nature that engages the phenomenon of religious and cultural theory broadly construed.
